anes_panel <- anes_panel %>%
  mutate(

    trust_gov_index = if_else(
      trust_gov_index == 999,
      NA_real_,
      as.numeric(trust_gov_index)
    ),

    # Economic views
    econ_views = case_when(
      as.numeric(econ_views) %in% c(1, 3, 5) ~ as.numeric(econ_views),
      as.numeric(econ_views) %in% c(8, 9) ~ NA_real_,

    stock_owns = case_when(

    homeowner = case_when(
      as.numeric(homeowner) == 1 ~ 1,
      as.numeric(homeowner) == 2 ~ 0,

```{r Step 2: Pooled Model of Relationship between Personal Finance and External Efficacy, include=TRUE}
# Officials care what people like me think
care_finance_time <- anes_panel %>%
  filter(
    year >= 2000,
    year <= 2024,
    !is.na(government_care),
    !is.na(personal_finances_scale_factor),
    !is.na(VCF0009z)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    government_care_agree = as.numeric(government_care == 1)
  )

design_care_finance_time <- survey::svydesign(
  ids = ~1,
  weights = ~VCF0009z,
  data = care_finance_time
)

model_care_finance_time <- survey::svyglm(
  government_care_agree ~ personal_finances_scale_factor * factor(year),
  design = design_care_finance_time,
  family = quasibinomial()
)


# People like me have a say in government
say_finance_time <- anes_panel %>%
  filter(
    year >= 2000,
    year <= 2024,
    !is.na(government_say),
    !is.na(personal_finances_scale_factor),
    !is.na(VCF0009z)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    government_say_agree = as.numeric(government_say == 1)
  )

design_say_finance_time <- survey::svydesign(
  ids = ~1,
  weights = ~VCF0009z,
  data = say_finance_time
)

model_say_finance_time <- survey::svyglm(
  government_say_agree ~ personal_finances_scale_factor * factor(year),
  design = design_say_finance_time,
  family = quasibinomial()
)

care_finance_predictions <- ggpredict(
  model_care_finance_time,
  terms = c("personal_finances_scale_factor", "year")
)

say_finance_predictions <- ggpredict(
  model_say_finance_time,
  terms = c("personal_finances_scale_factor", "year")
)

care_finance_predictions
say_finance_predictions


#Joint Test
test_finance_year_interaction <- function(mod) {

  coef_names <- names(coef(mod))

  # Find the personal-finance × year interaction terms
  interaction_idx <- grep(
    "personal_finances_scale_factor",
    coef_names
  )

  interaction_idx <- interaction_idx[
    grepl(
      "factor\\(year\\)",
      coef_names[interaction_idx]
    )
  ]

  # Check that interactions were found
  if (length(interaction_idx) == 0) {
    stop(
      "No personal_finances_scale_factor × year interaction terms found."
    )
  }

  beta <- coef(mod)[interaction_idx]

  V <- vcov(mod)[
    interaction_idx,
    interaction_idx,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  W <- as.numeric(
    t(beta) %*% solve(V) %*% beta
  )

  q <- length(beta)

  F_stat <- W / q
  df_den <- mod$df.residual

  p_value <- pf(
    F_stat,
    df1 = q,
    df2 = df_den,
    lower.tail = FALSE
  )

  data.frame(
    F = F_stat,
    df1 = q,
    df2 = df_den,
    p = p_value
  )
}
test_finance_year_interaction(model_care_finance_time)

test_finance_year_interaction(model_say_finance_time)
```

# -----------------------------

care_stock_pooled <- tidy(
  model_care_finance_stock,
  conf.int = TRUE
) %>%
  filter(
    grepl("personal_finances_scale_factor.*:stock_owns", term)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    odds_ratio = exp(estimate),
    conf_low_or = exp(conf.low),
    conf_high_or = exp(conf.high)
  )

say_stock_pooled <- tidy(
  model_say_finance_stock,
  conf.int = TRUE
) %>%
  filter(
    grepl("personal_finances_scale_factor.*:stock_owns", term)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    odds_ratio = exp(estimate),
    conf_low_or = exp(conf.low),
    conf_high_or = exp(conf.high)
  )

care_stock_pooled
say_stock_pooled

pooled_stock_table <- bind_rows(
  care_stock_pooled %>%
    transmute(
      term,
      care_estimate = estimate,
      care_se = std.error,
      care_p = p.value,
      care_or = odds_ratio,
      care_low = conf_low_or,
      care_high = conf_high_or
    ),

  say_stock_pooled %>%
    transmute(
      term,
      say_estimate = estimate,
      say_se = std.error,
      say_p = p.value,
      say_or = odds_ratio,
      say_low = conf_low_or,
      say_high = conf_high_or
    )
) %>%
  group_by(term) %>%
  summarise(
    care_estimate = first(na.omit(care_estimate)),
    care_se = first(na.omit(care_se)),
    care_p = first(na.omit(care_p)),
    care_or = first(na.omit(care_or)),
    care_low = first(na.omit(care_low)),
    care_high = first(na.omit(care_high)),
    
    say_estimate = first(na.omit(say_estimate)),
    say_se = first(na.omit(say_se)),
    say_p = first(na.omit(say_p)),
    say_or = first(na.omit(say_or)),
    say_low = first(na.omit(say_low)),
    say_high = first(na.omit(say_high)),
    
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    term = recode(
      term,
      "personal_finances_scale_factorSomewhat better:stock_owns" =
        "Somewhat better × Stock owner",
      "personal_finances_scale_factorSame:stock_owns" =
        "Same × Stock owner",
      "personal_finances_scale_factorSomewhat worse:stock_owns" =
        "Somewhat worse × Stock owner",
      "personal_finances_scale_factorMuch worse:stock_owns" =
        "Much worse × Stock owner"
    )
  )

#Formal Omnibus Test
test_three_way <- function(model) {
  
  coef_names <- names(coef(model))
  
  interaction_idx <- grep(
    "personal_finances_scale_factor.*:stock_owns.*:year_factor|",
    coef_names
  )
  
  interaction_idx <- interaction_idx[
    grepl(
      "personal_finances_scale_factor.*stock_owns.*year_factor",
      coef_names
    )
  ]
  
  beta <- coef(model)[interaction_idx]
  V <- vcov(model)[interaction_idx, interaction_idx, drop = FALSE]
  
  W <- as.numeric(
    t(beta) %*% solve(V) %*% beta
  )
  
  q <- length(beta)
  
  F_stat <- W / q
  df_den <- model$df.residual
  
  p_value <- pf(
    F_stat,
    df1 = q,
    df2 = df_den,
    lower.tail = FALSE
  )
  
  tibble(
    F = F_stat,
    df1 = q,
    df2 = df_den,
    p = p_value
  )
} 

care_three_way_test <- test_three_way(
  model_care_finance_stock_time
)

say_three_way_test <- test_three_way(
  model_say_finance_stock_time
)

care_three_way_test
say_three_way_test
